items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Is Spending $15 Billion On Malaysia Data Centers
items.summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS:GOOGL) announced a US$15b investment to expand Google data centers and AI infrastructure in Malaysia in 2026. The Malaysian expansion includes new cloud facilities intended to support regional AI demand from enterprise and public sector clients. An Alphabet shareholder filed a lawsuit against senior executives alleging Google's AI models were trained on copyrighted material without proper authorization. The US$15b Malaysia build out and the new copyright lawsuit only...
